data.name: Kat
data.gender_notes: Kat is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'Aikatō', meaning 'downy-haired'. This name was also used as a short form of 'Katherine' or 'Katharina', which means 'pure' or 'clean'. The name Kat carries the meaning “Pure, Clean” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Kat usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, clean and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kat total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
